meta.title: Osppy · Business and technology consulting
meta.description: Osppy is a business and technology consultancy, AI-native and deeply human. We help you reimagine your company from a digital perspective.

quienes.frase: Osppy is a business and technology consultancy, AI-native and deeply human. We help you reimagine your company from a digital perspective.
quienes.origen: We came to consulting from building and operating systems that work in real businesses today. That is why we start with the business, not the tool.

proposito.texto: That the companies we work with prosper and compete at the highest level. We believe technology is worth it when the people who run and operate a business understand it, use it and make it their own.

creemos.texto: That people and the business come first, and technology second. That artificial intelligence is not a separate project, but a way of working. That the best solutions are built with the client's team and stay with it.

etapas.texto: We understand your operation in depth: how your people work, where the information lives and what really hurts.
We turn what we find into a strategic plan: what comes first, what follows and what is not worth it yet, with scope and success criteria in writing.
We build hand in hand with you and leave it running. If your people can do it, we train them to do it.
We stay until your team walks on its own, and then we stay close: operation, maintenance and whatever comes next.

estrategia.texto: Deciding what technology your business needs, in what order and for what, before buying anything.

datos.texto: Bringing together the information that is scattered today, organizing it and making sure your people can read it.

ia.texto: Putting artificial intelligence to work inside your operation (answering, classifying, drafting, reviewing), with a person who decides.

nube.texto: Moving and modernizing your systems, and operating them in an orderly way.

sistemas.texto: Implementing and connecting the applications your team and your customers work with.

experiencia.texto: Designing how your customers and your people live each process, from first contact to service.

producto.texto: Building the product or platform your business needs, from the inside, not just configuring it.

entrega.texto: Taking the project from start to finish: scope, priorities, dates and deliveries.

meta.title: Privacy notice · Osppy
meta.description: Osppy's privacy notice under the Mexican LFPDPPP.

intro: This notice is issued under the Mexican Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), its Regulations and the Privacy Notice Guidelines. The Spanish version is the legally operative one.
We recommend reading it in full before giving us any personal data.

secciones.titulo: Identity and address of the controller
parrafos: Osppy is a trade name. The company is in the process of incorporation and this notice will be updated with its legal name and address as soon as it is incorporated.
For any matter related to your personal data, the contact channel is hello@osppy.com.
Only what you write in this site's contact form: name, email, phone, company, role, country, city and whatever you tell us in the message.
In addition, our hosting provider records technical data about the connection, such as the IP address, to operate the site and protect it from abuse.
Primary, necessary to answer you: reply to your message, understand whether we can help you and follow up on that conversation.

Secondary, not necessary: send you emails from Osppy, only if you checked that box. If you do not want the secondary purposes, simply leave it unchecked or write to us at hello@osppy.com; your refusal does not affect the reply to your message.
We neither request nor require it. If you provide it voluntarily in the message, its processing is strictly limited to the purposes described here.
Your message arrives as an email at hello@osppy.com. This site does not store it in any database.

Two providers act as processors so that it arrives: the site's hosting provider and the email delivery provider, both located in the United States, which process the data solely on our behalf and under our instructions, and for which we adopt measures aimed at an adequate level of protection.
We do not sell, rent or transfer your data to third parties for purposes other than those described, except in the cases provided for in article 37 of the LFPDPPP or when we have your consent.
This site uses no tracking cookies, no advertising and no analytics tools. The only thing stored in your browser is whether you choose light or dark mode, and that never leaves your device.

secciones.titulo: The WhatsApp assistant has its own notice
parrafos: If you arrived here from a conversation with an Osppy assistant on WhatsApp, the processing of those messages is governed by that service's notice, which is a document separate from this one.

secciones.titulo: How to exercise your ARCO rights
parrafos: You have the right to access your personal data, rectify it when inaccurate, cancel it when you consider it is not required for the stated purposes, and object to its processing.

To exercise them, send a request to hello@osppy.com stating: your name and a means to receive a reply; the documents proving your identity or, where applicable, legal representation; a clear description of the data over which you seek to exercise a right; and any element that helps locate it.
We answer within a maximum of twenty business days and, where the request is well founded, we make it effective within the following fifteen business days.

secciones.titulo: Withdrawal of consent and limitation of use
parrafos: You may withdraw your consent, as well as limit the use or disclosure of your data, by writing to hello@osppy.com. Legal obligations may require us to keep processing certain data for a set period.
We keep your message and your contact data for up to twenty-four months, or until you ask us to delete it, whichever comes first.
We implement reasonable administrative, technical and physical measures to protect your personal data against damage, loss, alteration, destruction or unauthorized use, access or processing.
We may update this notice. Any change is published on this same page, stating the date of the last update.
If you consider that your right to the protection of personal data has been infringed, you may turn to the competent authority to file the corresponding complaint.
By sending us the form you state that you have read, understood and accepted the terms of this notice.
